events.title: Chess Connect - Blitz
events.description:
## Event Details

Come join us for an evening of **chess, good games, and great company! ♟️**

Whether you play regularly or just enjoy sitting across the board and figuring out your next move, Chess Connect is a place to play, meet fellow chess lovers, and have a good time.

We'll have **3 hours of 5+3 Blitz**, with plenty of games to get your chess fix. And of course, there are some exciting prizes and lucky draws along the way! 👀

So bring your friends, bring your best moves, and come spend a few hours playing chess with the community.

**See you at Chess Connect! ♟️**

## What's Included

- ♟️ **3 Hours of Blitz Chess** — 5+3 format
- 🏆 **Prizes for the Top 3 Players**
- 🎁 **Lucky Draw:** Premium Chess Sets from Paramount Chess
- 💎 **Lucky Draw:** Chess.com Diamond Membership

events.title: Chess Connect: Team Battle
events.description:
## Event Details

Join us for the next edition of Chess Connect, this time with a thrilling team twist!

Whether you're an experienced player or a newcomer, come experience the excitement of team-based chess, make new friends, and enjoy a day of strategic fun.

## Event Highlights

- **Team Format:** Teams of 4 players
- **Swiss Style:** A Swiss-system tournament to ensure exciting matchups
- Chance to win **Premium Chess Sets** from Paramount Chess
- **Prizes:** Attractive BCC goodies for top teams
- **Game Format:** Swiss Team Blitz Chess (5+3)

## Registration Details

- **Individual registration:** Don't have a team? No problem — register as an individual and we'll group you with others based on skill level to form balanced teams for thrilling matchups.
- **Team registration:** Already have a team of four? Register together and dive straight into the team competition!

events.title: Chess Connect : Showdown
events.description:
## Event Details:

Join us for a one-of-a-kind chess event, Whether you're a grandmaster or a beginner, this is your chance to enjoy the game in a relaxed and friendly environment.
Sip on some of the finest beverages, meet fellow chess enthusiasts, engage in thrilling matches and create memorable moments over a shared passion for the game.

## What's Included:
- `Ticket includes food coupon ₹200`
- 3 Hours of multiple Fun-filled Chess Variants
- All games will be played in 5+3 time control

## Round Format:
- R1: Opening Challenge
- R2: 3-Check Chess
- R3: Antichess
- R4: King of the Hill
- R5: Racing Kings
- R6: Chess960

## Variant Details:

**Opening Challenge**:
Start from exciting and uncommon opening positions where both players must think creatively right from move one. A fun test of preparation, adaptability, and tactical awareness.

**3-Check Chess:**
Win the game by giving three checks to your opponent’s king. Traditional checkmate still works, but aggressive attacking play becomes the key strategy in this action-packed variant.

**Antichess:**
Forget everything you know about normal chess strategy! In Antichess, the goal is to lose all your pieces or get stalemated. Forced captures and creative sacrifices lead to chaotic and hilarious games.

**King of the Hill:**
Claim victory not only through checkmate, but also by bringing your king safely to the center of the board. A perfect mix of aggression, king activity, and unconventional strategy.

**Racing Kings:**
There’s no check or checkmate — the goal is simply to race your king to the eighth rank before your opponent does. Fast-paced, tactical, and completely different from standard chess.

**Chess960:**
Also known as Freestyle Chess, this variant randomizes the starting position of the back-rank pieces while keeping the game fully playable. Creativity and over-the-board thinking matter more than opening preparation.
